description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'QuickLaunchAPI' within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It provides an implementation for fetching quick launch shortcuts for the dashboard, including methods for retrieving accessible shortcuts based on user roles, and stub methods for creating and deleting shortcuts that are not yet implemented.

classes.name: QuickLaunchAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving quick launch shortcuts on the dashboard, with additional methods for creating and deleting shortcuts (not implemented). It extends the Endpoint class and uses traits for user role management.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all active quick launch items accessible to the user, returning them as a JSON response.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method; in this case, an empty collection indicating no specific validation constraints.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Stub method intended for creating new quick launch shortcuts, currently throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create method; currently not implemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Stub method intended for deleting shortcuts, currently throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete method; currently not implemented.

methods.name: getActiveQuickLaunchItemArray
methods.description: Generates an array indicating which quick launch items are active and accessible based on user roles; true/false flags.
